evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: Mandating a signed manifest before shipping appeals to security/stability (conservation) and quality-of-craft control (competence).

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Invoking a past failure as justification for a gate appeals to security and preventing recurrence — conservation.
The gate specification restates the security-and-craft-control mandate: conservation of integrity plus competence in the release process.
Extending the gate's scope to staging and production broadens the security/stability blanket — conservation.
Naming oneself as owner of the gate claims standing and accountability over the process — self-enhancement.
